F1: ensure_loaded!` is only called from `set_locale`, and `translate` only loads `config.locale`, so jobs and `with_locale` paths never load the fallback locales. A miss is then cached under a key built from the locale alone.
F2: The site setting is read from memory after the first load, so "a DB read on every lookup" is wrong. But the new `SiteSetting.default_locale` call inside every fallback lookup has no guard: it refreshes from the DB when no settings are loaded and can raise from inside I18n. `db.rake` guards the same call with `rescue :en`.
F3: set_locale` works today because `I18n.fallbacks` is always a `FallbackLocaleList`; the failure only happens if someone re-adds the config line later, which is not a current defect.
